identity: A mid-twentieth-century Arabic didactic essay titled 'بين القديم والجديد' (Between the Old and the New), arguing that the spirit of conservatism (روح المحافظة) and the impulse to renew (نزعة التجديد) are twin, inseparable forces in social and even biological life, and asking what the new Arab generation's stance should be. Register: formal expository MSA, first-person-plural lecturing voice (لاحظنا، وجدنا، نستطيع أن نقول، فلننظر، افرضوا، وتصوروا), balanced antithetical periods, heavy و/ف coordination, and absolute-object flourishes (مغالاة شديدة، استنكارا مطلقا، قطيعة تامة، زوالا تاما، تغيرا كليا، جرفا). Structure: token 0-2 is the title, one <NL> at index 3, then a single unbroken 947-token paragraph (indices 4-950), so nearly every decision is paragraph-internal.
law: A boundary falls where a predication closes and the next token opens a NEW predication that is not syntactically governed by it. Positive openers attested here: (a) asyndetic starts — أصبح (634), افرضوا (915), من المعلوم (819), ماذا (759), كل شيء (331), لا شك (938); (b) و + fresh subject or verb — ويغالي، ولا يكتفي، ولهذا، وتعتبر، وتظهر، ومما، ومن المعلوم، وقد، ولكن، والآن، وأما نحن فـ، ولا نغالي، ولا حاجة؛ (c) ف + إن or ف + verb after a closed statement — فإننا (35), فإن (833), فنستطيع (902), فلننظر (808), ففريق (691), فماذا (751); (d) غير أن، إن، إنما. Never a boundary (these are subordinators or correlatives, and the author uses all of them clause-internally): في حين أن، كما / كما أن، بل (as the correlate of a preceding لا), حتى إن، لأن، حيث، الذي/التي، عندئذ، دون أن، إلى أن — and و when it merely joins coordinate members of an enumeration or two verbs sharing one subject. Measured rhythm: 33 body sentences, mean ~29 tokens, range 11-60; long balanced antitheses of 55-60 tokens are normal for this author, so length alone never forces a split, but a declarative under ~11 tokens is suspect (questions may be shorter). <NL> itself never carries a boundary; the token before <NL> (2) and the final token (950) always do.
reasoning: SITE 93/102 (كما يغالي ... مغالاة شديدة | فإنهم): I first wanted a period at 102, since 73-131 is 59 tokens. Rejected. The exact string 'مغالاة شديدة + ف-' occurs twice in the same slot: at 80-81 (مغالاة شديدة فيستنكرون) it is certainly clause-internal, so at 102-103 (مغالاة شديدة فإنهم) it is too. The whole modernizers/conservatives antithesis is one balanced period, 73-131, closing at أيضا. SITE 200/215/216 (ولهذا يطلبون ... | في حين أننا نجد ... | عندئذ يفقد): في حين أن occurs four times (54, 201, 381, 416); two are unambiguously clause-internal — 54 sits under وجدنا أن, and 381 sits inside the بل-clause — so I treat it as a pure subordinator that never opens a sentence, and refuse a boundary at 200. Nor at 215: the conservative-era half was built as 'في بعض الأدوار تتغلب روح المحافظة ... فيكتسب ... ويصبح' (149), and the mirror half fills that same consequence slot with عندئذ (216) instead of ف, so عندئذ is clause-internal. The period lands at 229 (منه). SITE 415 (الإنكليز | الأمم الشرقية): same subordinator rule, reinforced by بعكس ذلك at 422 echoing its clause-internal use at 58; the English/Eastern comparison is one 55-token sentence, 392-446. SITE 391 (مثلا): مثلا cannot attach backward to 'في الميادين الأخرى' when the example itself follows, so it opens its sentence and the period precedes it at 391 — but bare sentence-initial مثلا is uncommon enough that I call this med. SITE 366 (وعلى حد سواء | بل): 'لا تتم ... بل كثيرا ما يحدث' is a لا...بل correlative, never split; 343-391 runs as one 49-token sentence. SITE 475 (منذ عدة أجيال | حتى الأعمال الزراعية): genuine coin flip between one 62-token sentence and a 29+33 split with حتى read as emphatic 'even' opening a sentence; the paired حتى ... وحتى (476, 496) reads well as its own emphatic sentence, so I split, marked lo. SITE 529 (لكل قضية | وصار الدرس): three و-chained verbs (أحيطت، اعتبرت، صار), but صار brings a new subject (الدرس والبحث والتفكير) and launches the five-fold anaphora of الكتب القديمة, which reads as its own closing period; med. SITE 564 (تغيرا كليا | وقد فقدت): tempting as a short pivot sentence, but 557-564 would be an 8-token declarative, below this author's observed floor of 11 for non-questions, and 'ولكن ... وقد ... وأخذت' chains smoothly; folded into 557-590. SITE 690 (ومتخالفين | ففريق منا): the ف unpacks متخالفين into the three-فريق tricolon; I take a period rather than a colon, matching the ف-openers at 35 and 833. The tricolon 691-750 stays whole — the two internal وفريق (712, 730) are coordinate list members, not sentence starts. SITE 750/758 (فماذا ... | ماذا ...): two juxtaposed rhetorical questions, the second asyndetic, so question-mark boundaries at 750 and 758. SITE 606/633: 'أصبحت فيه ... وصارت كل الأمور' both modify دور and stay inside 591-633; the asyndetic أصبح at 634, which restates بسرعة هائلة, is the real restart. SITE 931 (وبنائها القديم | وتصوروا): افرضوا and وتصوروا are two و-joined imperatives in one rhetorical move; kept as one sentence 915-937. Mandatory anchors honored: boundary at 2 (last token before the only <NL>) and at 950 (final token); index 3 (<NL>) carries none.
